items.title: What If Jesus Has Already Returned?  Tom Gouws
items.description:
Did Jesus keep his promise?  Jesus promised many, many, many times, that he would be gone only a short while, and that he would return soon.  He promised to never leave of forsake his followers, or leave them as orphans.  Did he do that?

items.title: YESTERDAY'S NEWSREELS    PRIME MINISTER DAVID LLOYD GEORGE    PROHIBITION  MARY PICKFORD 55854
items.description: <div>This black and white film is one of the episodes of "Yesterday's Newsreels", an early 1950s TV show made from the General Newsreel collection. It features eight segments of historic highlights. David Lloyd George 1915-1923. England’s Prime Minister is shown giving a speech in 1915 footage.  Geo
